recommendation: Keep the audit commit as the core-spec record. If current IG Publisher output still omits CodeSystem designation content, file or fix the issue in HL7/fhir-ig-publisher.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive FHIR-core issue from STU3 asking the IG builder's generated CodeSystem XHTML to show concept designation content, including designation use and value, instead of only code, display, and definition.
initial_application: No Jira-tagged FHIR source commit for FHIR-13557 was found. The active core CodeSystem source already defines CodeSystem.concept.designation and its language, use, additionalUse, and value children.
additional_context: The Jira issue is grouped as FHIR-Tools-IG, and Grahame Grieve's 2022 comment says this is an old tooling issue and should be raised in https://github.com/HL7/fhir-ig-publisher/issues if still present. The current FHIR checkout contains no in-scope Java renderer implementation.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit on the combined branch and made no core source changes because the requested behavior belongs in the external IG Publisher tooling repository.

evidence_items.summary: Published/Persuasive FHIR-Tools-IG issue requesting IG builder CodeSystem XHTML to display concept designation content, with a later comment redirecting any remaining issue to HL7/fhir-ig-publisher.
evidence_items.learned: The final Jira request concerns tooling behavior rather than a missing CodeSystem model definition in the current core source.

evidence_items.summary: CodeSystem is an active resource and the StructureDefinition defines CodeSystem.concept.designation and its language/use/value children.
evidence_items.learned: Core CodeSystem source already contains the designation semantics that the renderer should display.

evidence_items.summary: CodeSystem narrative says concepts can have designation elements and describes their language and purpose uses.
evidence_items.learned: The core narrative is not missing designation guidance that would justify a source edit for this tooling issue.
